decisions_this_run: D-069a: a closed factor-family vocabulary, not an open one. An unrecognised AMR method is ignored, which can only understate assurance; understating costs a step-up prompt, overstating spends an obligation.

D-069b: `otp` and `sms` are separate families. A one-time code and an SMS message are different channels even when the code is delivered by SMS; this keeps pwd+otp multi-factor without letting sms+tel through.
D-069c: did not use ACR values. ACR is issuer-defined, so trusting it for strength trusts the issuer's policy instead of our own; `amr` names methods we can classify inside our trust boundary.
D-069d: a first draft test asserted otp+totp+sms was single-factor and failed. The test was wrong (two families), so the case was replaced, not the assertion loosened.
run_summary: NEX-067 closes the P1 the PR review named three runs ago: derive_assurance() counted distinct AMR method names, so otp+totp (one factor, two spellings) satisfied the step-up obligation that demands two factors. Methods now map to a closed family vocabulary and MFA requires two independent families. Proved by 12 regression cases that fail when only the family guard is reverted. 1460 passed / 4 skipped; CI 4/4 on c01fde5.

head_drift_policy: `commit` names the last head whose *product* code was verified by CI, not necessarily the branch tip. NEXUS checkpoint updates are themselves docs-only commits, so the tip advances one commit past `commit` every time this file is written - chasing it is an unbounded loop (run 64 hit this: 7456a89 -> 974d03f -> c49befe, each fix creating a new tip). On reconciliation, compare the product tree, not the SHA: `git diff <commit>..HEAD -- src/ tests/` being empty means `commit` is still an accurate description of what CI verified.
commit_note: A checkpoint commit cannot name itself. 787ed57 is the last substantive commit; every later commit on this branch is a docs-only checkpoint that descends from it, so its CI still compiles and tests the same product code. To find the live head, poll `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/feature/agentic-enterprise-platform` rather than trusting this field. Each such docs commit also cancels the previous head's in-flight CI (branch concurrency), so `conclusion: cancelled` means superseded, never failed.
